encode_keypoints_for_pose_lifting: encode 2D keypoints and 3D lifting targets into normalized space for video pose lifting
decode_lifted_keypoints: decode normalized 3D keypoints back to global coordinates using the stored target root
initialize_video_pose_lifting_codec: initialize a VideoPoseLifting codec with configurable zero centering, root removal, and camera normalization options
review_VideoPoseLifting_encode: review the VideoPoseLifting encode method to understand how keypoints are normalized and weights are computed
refactor_VideoPoseLifting_decode: refactor the VideoPoseLifting decode method to support additional coordinate transformation options
